recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if FHIR publication tooling changes global mapping-space rendering; there is no Patient-specific source fix needed for FHIR-18324.
issue_request: FHIR-18324 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient technical correction reporting that the Patient mappings section link http://hl7.org/fhir/fivews returned an HL7 404 and should be corrected.
initial_application: Jira records a 2018-11-08 fixed comment. No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18324 was found, but commit fc4ada05433e0fb0f903d430fef9cc70ad1a4119, titled "GF#18326 - fix mapping spaces links", added source/mappingSpaces.xml links including the FiveWs mapping URL to http://hl7.org/fhir/fivews.html.
additional_context: Patient is an active resource, FiveWs is an active logical model, and current source intentionally separates the canonical mapping-space URL from the human-facing documentation link. FHIR-18326 is a sibling Patient mapping-link issue already audited on the combined branch; FHIR-18323 is an adjacent same-section CSS/link-visibility issue not needed to decide this link-target correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/mappingSpaces.xml already supplies the corrected fivews.html link while source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml correctly preserves the canonical mapping URI.

related_jiras.note: Sibling Patient mappings link issue whose GF#18326 implementation commit also added the FiveWs mapping-space link used to satisfy FHIR-18324; already audited on the combined branch.
Adjacent FiveWs mapping heading visibility/CSS issue on the same Patient mappings section, but it is a separate rendering concern and was not decided here.
